FailHvRunCommand first attributes a nonzero exit or launch failure to the reviewer and marks it Offline without checking the version. An old probe of configuration v1 can therefore take v2 Offline after UpdateHvReviewerCommand has made v2 Unverified and requested its probe. Specify configuration-change, shutdown and lease-recovery behavior without reopening the corrupt-probe loop. Add a restart regression case to FR/TR/TEST-003.
